arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.request_id,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select group_concat(c.charge_id||":"||c.idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select * from charges where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="pending")
select service,status,count(*) n,max(message) m from request_logs group by service,status
select id,service,path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=500 order by id desc limit 10

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.client_reference,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) c,(select group_concat(state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) cs,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) k,(select count(*) from refunds r where r.booking_id=b.booking_id) r from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or h!=1 or c!=1 or k!=1 or cs!="captured"
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where service="booking" order by id desc limit 14
select name,sql from sqlite_master where name in ("customer_events","outbox","fare_holds","bookings")
select status,count(*),min(attempts),max(attempts) from outbox group by status
select service,status,count(*) n,max(id) last from request_logs where id>300 group by service,status

select client_reference,count(*) from bookings where client_reference is not null and status="confirmed" group by 1 having count(*)>1 union all select "cap "||flight_id, count(*) from holds group by flight_id union all select "flt "||flight_id||" cap", capacity from flights
